decided: Patrick, 16 October 2026, A on #2553: Thornswood measures its own spots for the kilns, salt quarries, beehives and alchemy labs, the way the woodworking benches were placed, and the content plugin places them.

hive.name: beehive
hive.rule: One at each of Skyrim's own named farms that has at least 5 crop plots of the farmer's table within 2,400 units, the farm claim's circle, of the farm's point: its map marker, or the farmhouse's outside door where that marker is inside the house. It stands beside the crop plot nearest that point. A placed hive is a farmer verb (farmer.md).

kiln.name: charcoal kiln
kiln.rule: One for each of the nine towns with a woodworking bench, outside the town: beside the chopping block in the open world nearest that town's forge, among those 1,000 units or more from every bench (#2337), within 12,000 units of the forge, or 20,000 for Solitude and Markarth, whose nearest blocks are at Katla's Farm and Salvius Farm. It may stand among small plants, the way Skyrim's smelters do (Patrick, B on #2553). The kiln turns the firewood split at a chopping block into the charcoal every forge burns (charburner.md, smith.md).

lab.name: alchemy lab
lab.rule: One in the apothecary of each of the nine hold capitals, the shop Skyrim marks as a store that holds Skyrim's own alchemy lab, beside that lab; Winterhold has no apothecary in town, so the College's Hall of Countenance. The poultice and the remedy are made only at Thornswood's lab (physicker.md, injury.md).

river.name: water bucket
river.rule: One on the river nearest each of the nine towns with a forge (#1382), the nearest clear spot to the forge within 3,000 units whose cell's water is river water by game/data/waters.json, and one on Lake Honrich at Riften, whose water the records call deep. At the edge: ground no lower than that water and no more than 120 units above it, and navmesh under the water within 160 units, so the water is there to reach. Patrick, 12 October 2026, approved drawing spots at rivers and lakes on #1382, and 20 October 2026: lake water is worth what river water is, so one bucket serves both, and both must be boiled.

salt.name: salt quarry
salt.rule: One on the shore of each hold capital on the Sea of Ghosts (Solitude, Windhelm, Dawnstar, Winterhold), beside the boat drawn up nearest the town: its forge, or Winterhold's smithing anvil. The quarry is an ore vein, so it is set into rock the way Skyrim's veins are: only the place the miner stands needs clear, dry, flat ground, and the vein lies on ground no lower than its underside or inside a rock or cliff (Patrick, B on #2553). Salt comes from the sea (miner.md, the salt quarry).

well.name: well bucket
well.rule: One beside each of the placed wells in game/data/wells.json (#1382): the wells are statics and raise no activation, so the bucket is what somebody activates to draw water there (Patrick, 12 October 2026, approved on #1382). A well in a cell no master of the content plugin carries is left out, because the plugin can only place into its masters' cells.

leftOut.FalkreathLodsHouseLocation: Lod's house in Falkreath, which Skyrim marks as a farm, has 3 crop plots within 2,400 units of its door: a smith's yard, not a field.

measure: Each station stands at the nearest clear spot to its anchor, tried every step units out to its reach in eight turns of the anchor's angle, a turn costing 60 units. Its outline and its user's place lie on the navmesh, on ground flat to the kind's flat and within 60 units of the anchor's height, out of doors above the water, and touch no furniture, container, door, item, plant or static under 250 by 250, nor where anybody stands at other furniture, the way through a door, a woodworking bench, a notice board, or another station, from 6 to 140 units above the floor, with 30 units to the nearest solid thing. A kiln stands 1000 units or more from every woodworking bench. A kiln may stand among small plants, and a salt vein is set into rock: only its miner's place needs the ground (Patrick, B on #2553). The cell and worldspace records the plugin carries are Bethesda's and change nothing in the game.
